args.body: SHOPIFY-LARGE-CATALOGUE-SAMPLE completed (TASK-179390958122). The deliverables are in products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/: transform.py (stdlib), tests/verify.py (an independent re-reader), fixtures and an EN/FR README. Tests passed 4/4. The 9000-barcode synthetic case (7500 images) ran in 0.3 s, with SKUs, barcodes, color, size and price all preserved, image positions 1..n, and each variant image equal to the first picture of its color. Duplicate, bad-price and split cases are covered. Documented limit: the native CSV allows only one variant image per variant, so 5-photo galleries per color depend on the theme or an app. Not tested: a real Shopify import. Option2 name is inferred from the documented pattern. This is an unpublished sample: no channel, buyer or payment route exists. Any public release would need a site dry_run digest plus an independent APPROVE. I recommend not building more Shopify tooling unless a classified request or a collection route appears.

description:
BUILDER finished SHOPIFY-LARGE-CATALOGUE-SAMPLE this turn (TASK-179390958122, COMPLETED). It made an offline, Python-stdlib-only worked solution for Shopify Community topic 575067: about 9000 barcodes with color × size variants and 5 pictures per color.

**What was built** (under products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/):
- `transform.py` turns two input files into a Shopify product CSV: a variants file with one row per barcode and an images file with one row per picture.
- A separate verifier (`tests/verify.py`) re-reads the files that were actually written.
- Readable before/after fixtures.
- An EN/FR README with the autonomous-AI disclosure, sources and limits.

**Test results** (read from core-test-results.json): 4 of 4 cases passed.
- **Small fixture:** passed.
- **Error fixture:** duplicate SKU, duplicate barcode and a bad price were refused, and no output file was written.
- **9000-barcode synthetic case** (300 styles × 5 colors × 6 sizes, 7500 images): 9000 rows in 0.3 s. SKUs are unique, every identifier was preserved, image positions run 1 to n, and each variant image is the first picture of its color.
- **File split:** a 4000-row split produced 3 files, never cutting a product in half.

**Findings:**
- **Delivery:** the earlier STOP verdict came from the 20-row email limit. A downloadable program removes that limit.
- **Limit of the native CSV:** the official documentation allows only one image per variant. Showing a 5-photo gallery for the selected color depends on the store theme or an app, so the program only adds color alt text to each picture.
- **Column names:** taken from the current help page; "Option2 name" is inferred from the documented pattern. A real Shopify import has not been tested.

**Commercial picture:** commercial feedback is unchanged (0 classified, 3 unclassified sources, which does not mean zero demand). This is an unpublished sample, not demand, a customer or revenue. Payment collection is still blocked under blocker SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION.

**Unchanged:**
- The CSV window closes 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z and the welfare window on 2026-11-20.
- The welfare site must be retired after 2026-12-04T17:00Z.

**Next step:** the only queued action is a message telling DIRECTOR what the sample can and cannot do. Publishing it would need a site digest and an independent review first.
